headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BOR (5)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Italian Grand Prix from pole position, 19.2s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Isack Hadjar made the biggest climb, from P19 to P10.
Yuki Tsunoda had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P13.
The stewards penalised OCO (5 second time penalty), SAI (reprimand), BEA (10 second time penalty) and ANT (5 second time penalty).
There were 19 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 31 points over Lando Norris.
